candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order spans fail with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size 5 and idle 0, so checkout requests time out at the gateway and return 502. Pool exhaustion at the order->postgres dependency is the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or logs; pool size 5 with idle 0 is consistent with exhaustion but saturation cause (leak vs load) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing: order->postgres save_order returns DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0, order returns 503, gateway returns 502 after ~2s. Inventory and payment calls succeed. Gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2406ms. Bounded candidate: postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool metrics (wait time, active/max connections) for the order service
Postgres server logs or slow-query data around the failure window
Order service logs confirming pool acquisition timeouts
